blends.desc:
The Return of the Mogged Pepe

The charge has ended, the battle won — now the chivalric frog returns to his treasury.

Blend your Charge of the Mogged Pepe NFT to honor the warrior’s campaign and claim your 1 billion WAXPEPE reward.

The mogged never rest… they simply recharge. 🐸⚔️

One blend. One billion reasons to mog again.
